steps.title: Demand
steps.say: Demand slopes down: the higher the price, the less people want to buy.

steps.title: Supply
steps.say: Supply slopes up: the higher the price, the more sellers want to sell.

steps.title: Equilibrium
steps.say: Where the curves cross, buyers and sellers agree. That gives the equilibrium price 5 and quantity 5.

steps.title: Demand rises
steps.say: If demand rises, the demand curve moves right. The equilibrium slides up along supply, so price and quantity both go up.

steps.title: Back to start
steps.say: Now let's return demand to normal, so we can look at supply on its own.

steps.title: Quiz: supply falls
steps.say: Now suppose supply falls, so the supply curve moves left. Drag the dot to where you think the new equilibrium will be.

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.say: Well done. Now drag the curves yourself and watch how the price and quantity respond.
